identification: Silky oak lift-top washstand with towel rail, inset enamel basin, small mirror in lid, cupboard below with enamel jug and bowl. Brass plaque F. TRITTON LIMITED, House Furnishers & Manufacturers, 260 George Street, Brisbane (title's 'limited edition' is a misreading). Tritton was a major Brisbane maker using Queensland silky oak; plaque form suggests c.1910s-1930s. Common maker, uncommon form, but no collector premium evidenced.

entries.note: Vintage Arts & Crafts oak tile-back washstand with marble top, not silky oak, not Tritton, not lift-top. Snippet only, price not verified. Converted at about 0.92 AUD per NZD (assumed rate).
Rare Australian fiddle back blackwood washstand, a far better timber and form than this lot. Retail ask only. Snippet only, not verified. Upper bound for category, not a comparable.
